notes.title: Brand new Toy Train levels are here!
notes.content:
[h2]All aboard Danny's favorite Toy Train ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/38d979b52f2ee3b1e966266e3c4569cf7247c671.png[/img]

Now you can play the new toy-train levels in the second room ([b]Danny's room[/b]). This is a cute ([b]not really[/b]) toy with a deadly shadow ([b]and why does it have those horns??[/b]).
 
For all those who love the extra platforming challenge, the Toy Train will test your brain and your fingers at the same time. OR you can be smart and find ways to use the toy train efficiently?

Let us know what you think.

____________________________________________________________________


Join the Discord server of the game to share all your cool suggestions and feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/4b3f1ce6b1967dcf89b2a920cc5e8af4e48ded40.jpg[/img]

Also, If you already own the game, it would be really helpful if you could leave a review. Know more about us at our [url=https://inmyshadow.com][b]website[/b][/url]. 

Thank you!

notes.title: v1.3 : Steam Achievements, Refined narrative and much more!
notes.content:
[h1]In My Shadow v1.3 is here![/h1]

Hey everyone, 

We've got a few major improvements in this build. 


[h2][b]Refined Narrative[/b][/h2]
We've analysed all your feedback about the story and tried our best to improve it in a way we could convey the real emotion that we strongly feel everyone can relate to.


[h2][b]22 Steam Achievements[/b][/h2]
Better late than never. You will have to be on top of your shadow game for some of these!



[h2][b]Better platforming[/b][/h2]
Even though the game was improved quite a lot with the last update, this build focuses on not just fixing the glitches but providing a more enjoyable experience. The smoother platforming will make sure of that!



____________________________________________________________________

Happy shadow platforming everyone

Thank you!

notes.title: v1.2 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]In My Shadow v1.2 is out on Steam![/h1]

Like I said earlier, I have been listening to all the feedback about all the common issues/complaints about the game and the game will be constantly improving. This update has improved a lot of the visual implementation of the game's narrative - a common complaint among all the players. 


These are the major features and changes in this update - 

[h2][b]Enhanced Graphics[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/7e8ee674bc3dc4d24dbe58184a5b7a5b38d84616.png[/img]
The game's overall visuals have improved a lot providing a much cleaner and softer look to the shadow gameplay.


[h2][b]Better looking memories[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/4aadb01312c9e65f70b827db14e03301135f892d.png[/img]
A totally new, improved and dreamy look to the in-game narrative memory snippets.



[h2][b]Improved Game Progress Management[/b][/h2]

The game progress is managed in a much more flexible way providing you a seamless and convenient experience of progressing through the world of shadows.



____________________________________________________________________

There are a lot of minor under-the-hood improvements as well but I'll spare you the details for those.
I truly hope you enjoy the new and improved version of In My Shadow. If you haven't already, join the Discord server of the game to share all your cool suggestions and feedback!



[url=https://inmyshadow.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/4b3f1ce6b1967dcf89b2a920cc5e8af4e48ded40.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Update v1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Here's our first patch for In My Shadow that looks to improve your experience with the shadows.

Firstly, thank you for purchasing and playing In My Shadow. I am so happy to see that people have liked the shadow puzzles and have enjoyed playing the game. I have been listening to all the feedback about all the common issues/complaints about the game and can assure you that the game will be constantly improving and updating from now on. Thank you for sharing your reviews! :)

Now the patch , these are the major fixes that have been done in this patch along with a few minor fixes that does not affect the experience - 
 [list]
[*] Game framerate set according to the user's screen and hence it won't take up a lot of GPU to run anymore.
[*] A lot of collision hitboxes refined along with more precise platforming in the 4th room, both leading to a much better platforming experience.
[*] Game progress/save system- more dynamic and you can play a new game without losing your progress.
[*] Misc. UI improvements
[*] Player animation improvements
[/list]

I hope you will be able to notice the difference. If you face any issues, please feel free to share them on either the community hub (Feedback and bugs Discussion) or join the Discord where we do much more than just fix bugs :)

[url=https://inmyshadow.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38791185/4b3f1ce6b1967dcf89b2a920cc5e8af4e48ded40.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you and stay tuned for bigger updates!
